rules.coverage_text: Rental units subject to Berkeley rent stabilization whose landlords qualify under Regulation 1148.

exemptions.description: Tenancies that began on or after Jan 1, 2025 with rents set under Costa-Hawkins are not adjusted by the 2026 AGA.
exemptions.quote:
The 2026 AGA may not adjust tenants’ rents when their tenancy began on or after 
January 1, 2025, and who had their rents set pursuant to the Costa-Hawkins Rental 
Housing Act.

key_values.name: AGA formula
key_values.text: 65% of the increase in the Consumer Price Index

rules.quote:
adopted the Annual General Adjustment (AGA) Order for Year 2026 which will allow 
eligible landlords to increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than 
January 1, 2026.
rules.requirement: Eligible landlords may raise 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than January 1, 2026. The AGA equals 65% of the Bay Area CPI increase.
rules.title: Berkeley 2026 Annual General Adjustment
